subject: SIG questionnaire — canonical access artifacts needed for review
messages:
From: Emilia Grant <sigmgr@sigma-trust.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG artifact request — access control examples

Hi Hannah,

We're working through the SIG questionnaire for SigmaTrust and the assessor team has asked for a canonical set of access-control artifacts to validate controls around SSO, SCIM, and RBAC. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following items as part of the SIG intake?

- SAML assertion samples (3–5 examples) covering successful login flows and an expired assertion example (last 30 days)
- SCIM delta export showing adds/updates/deletes for a sample tenant (last 7 days)
- RBAC role matrix mapping roles -> privileges and an owner roster for each role
- A short service-account inventory (names, purpose, owner) and any JIT / approval runbook snippets
- Example SSO login events (audit log entries) for 2 service accounts and 2 human users

We understand some fields will need redaction (PII). Please advise your redaction approach and the earliest date you can deliver these artifacts — the assessor is hoping to review materials by 2026-07-21.

If you prefer, the assessor team can take draft artifacts via a secure Drive link or a signed SFTP transfer.

Thanks,
Emilia Grant
SIG Coordinator — SigmaTrust
sigmgr@sigma-trust.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Emilia Grant <sigmgr@sigma-trust.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:05:24 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG artifact request — access control examples

Emilia — thanks for the clear list. We can produce the bundle you describe. High-level plan:

- SAML assertion samples: we will provide 4 assertions (3 success, 1 expired). We will redact personally identifiable email addresses but preserve NameID formats and attributes (roles, org id).
- SCIM delta export: provide 7-day delta for a representative tenant in CSV; remove user emails and replace with pseudonymous IDs.
- RBAC matrix: current role->permission mapping as an XLSX with role owners (roles owners will be listed by title and team, not personal email).
- Service-account inventory: JSONL export (name, purpose, owner team, last-used timestamp).
- Audit samples: two human SSO events and two service-account token-use events (timestamps + event ids).

We plan to deliver a Drive folder with the artifacts by EOD 2026-07-17 unless you need an earlier window. If the assessor needs raw logs (unredacted) we can provide them under an NDA and a documented redaction checklist.

Please confirm whether pseudonymizing emails and exposing owner title/team is acceptable for SIG review. Once you confirm, we'll assemble and share a secure folder link and a checksum manifest.

— Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments (planned): saml_assertions_20260701-20260714.zip (archive, redacted), scim_delta_20260708-20260714.csv (redacted), rbac_role_matrix_2026-07.xlsx, service-account-inventory-2026-07.jsonl

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 10:14:03 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG artifact request — access control examples

Folks — forwarding the SIG request. Assigning owners so we hit the 7/17 delivery target:

- Jonas: collect SAML assertion samples (3 success + 1 expired), produce an export and apply the redaction checklist (replace user emails with pseudonyms, leave NameID format).
- Naomi: SCIM delta export (7 days) for the demo tenant and apply pseudonymization for emails; include SCIM change type column.
- Marcus: RBAC role matrix and service-account inventory; include owner team and owner title (no personal emails).

Please upload artifacts to the secure Drive folder below once ready and post the folder URL in the Jira ticket INFRA-3421 so I can share with Emilia. Also include a short readme (2–3 bullets) describing redaction steps taken.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSIG-ArtifactBundle
Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-3421

Let me know if any of the asks require legal or product sign-off. If we need raw logs for the assessor under NDA, escalate to legal.

Thanks — Hannah

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 15:42:11 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG artifact request — access control examples

Hannah / team — quick status update and a question on anonymization level.

Status:
- SAML assertions: packaged and redacted. Attached archive: saml_assertions_20260701-20260714.zip (contains 4 XML assertion examples; user identifiers replaced with pseudo IDs; attributes preserved).
- SCIM delta: scim_delta_20260708-20260714.csv uploaded (adds/updates/deletes included; pseudonymized user ids).
- RBAC matrix + inventory: rbac_role_matrix_2026-07.xlsx and service-account-inventory_2026-07.jsonl uploaded.

Question: for the RBAC owner field we currently have full names; policy recommends using owner title + team. Do we keep owner name or do title/team only? For SIG I recommend title/team; keeps linkage but avoids unnecessary PII.

I'll add short readme.txt and a manifest.txt with SHA256 checksums to the Drive folder now. Once Hannah confirms title/team is OK, I'll finalize and change file names to include "_redacted" suffix where appropriate.

Thanks,
Jonas
